entities.summary: Samuel Hlavaj is a Slovak professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Iowa Wild of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). Hlavaj has played for Slovakia senior team in the World Championships of 2023 and 2024.
